meta.title: Speaking Lab - German Exercise Bank
meta.instructions_for_app: For each exercise, play or show 'prompt_de'. The user listens (for repeat_after_me) or reads/responds (for other types), then speaks. Compare the recorded speech to 'prompt_de' (for repeat_after_me/read_aloud/tongue_twister) using speech-to-text + similarity/pronunciation scoring. For open-ended types (answer_question, opinion, roleplay, describe, story_starter, idiom, debate) score on: did they respond in German, relevance to the prompt, and rough fluency/length, since there's no single correct answer. Award 0 to max_points based on the scoring weights. To avoid boredom: shuffle exercise order within a level, mix types every 2-3 questions, don't repeat an id in the same session, and randomly select a subset (e.g. 10 per session) rather than showing all 30.
